prompt: A central angle in a circle intercepts an arc of $80^\circ$. An inscribed angle intercepts that same arc. What is the measure of the inscribed angle, in degrees?
hint: An inscribed angle is always half of the arc it intercepts.

hints.text: An inscribed angle is always half of the arc it intercepts.
The arc is $80^\circ$, so take half of it.

explanation: A central angle equals its intercepted arc, so the arc here is $80^\circ$.
An inscribed angle (vertex on the circle) is half its intercepted arc.

alternativeExplanations.title: Center beats edge
steps: Standing at the center, the arc fills your whole field of view: $80^\circ$.
Standing out on the rim, you are farther away and the same arc looks half as wide: $40^\circ$. Vertex at center = full arc, vertex on the circle = half.
